Copper Statistics and Information

Copper is one of the oldest metals ever used and has been one of the important materials in the development of civilization. Because of its properties, singularly or in combination, of high ductility, malleability, and thermal and electrical conductivity, and its resistance to corrosion, copper has become a major industrial metal.

The Mineral Commodity Summaries publication provides estimated domestic mine production, refinery production, consumption, trade and world mine production for the previous year. World mine production of copper was estimated at 23 million tons in 2025.

Publications

Annual publications include the Minerals Yearbook chapter on copper, the Mineral Commodity Summaries and the Mineral Industry Surveys, which are released monthly with production and consumption statistics.
